title: New York City Jet Ski

services.name: NYC Jet Ski
services.desc: When you think of going jet skiing, New York might not be the first destination that comes to mind. But imagine riding along the Big Apple’s shoreline on a brand-new 2025 SeaDoo - it’s truly an unforgettable experience. Picture yourself jetskiing 75 yards from the Statue of Liberty, feeling the thrill at 60 mph. No more missing out; see New York City like never before-on the back of a jet ski today! Skip the traffic and sidewalks full of people. Riding a jet ski along New York Harbor and the Hudson River is the best - and certainly least crowded - way to experience the city at any time of the day. With our newly added 2025 GTX-PRO and 2025 SeaDoo Switch, we offer top-of-the-line machines

services.name: New York Harbor Sunset Tour
services.desc: Visit some of New York City’s most iconic places from the back of a jet ski! This one-hour evening tour gives guests the chance to pilot their own jet skis around landmarks like the Statue of Liberty, Ellis Island, and the Freedom Tower. View the city’s remarkable sunset from New York Harbor and ask your New York City Jet Ski tour guide to take some pictures. Whether you’re a New York native or a first-time Big Apple visitor, this is an experience you won’t want to miss! For decades, Ellis Island in New York Harbor served as the ‘gateway’ to America for millions of immigrants.
